name: Open Job Cards
query:
SELECT
    name,
    customer_name,
    device_type,
    status,
    assigned_technician,
    estimated_cost,
    creation
FROM `tabJob Card`
WHERE status NOT IN ("Delivered", "Cancelled")
AND (
    IFNULL(%(device_type)s, '') = ''
    OR device_type = %(device_type)s
)
ORDER BY creation DESC
